title: Hover hints, round three — the ones I missed

steps.surface: The top bar and the composer
steps.path: The Chat / Terminal switch, the quick chips above the message box, and the mic
steps.headline: Hover the Chat and Terminal switch and the chips above the message box — is anything still the grey box?
steps.changed: You were right that the Chat/Terminal switch was missing. It is done, and so is the rest of the band that sweep had walked past: the ||| menu, the quick chips, the mic, the model-loading strip, and the note on an archived message — the /clear hint you first complained about in July.
steps.notice: The long explanations on the bottom bar are hovers again, as you asked. The circled i is gone from those chips; it stays only where it already was, on things you click for a fuller explanation.
steps.risk: The quick chips can be dragged to reorder. Wrapping one in a hint had quietly deleted that; it is fixed and pinned, but dragging a chip is worth a try while you are here.
